overview_description.description: ARM Holdings is a provider of silicon IP and custom SoCs at the heart of billions of devices. Its business model involves designing and licensing of IP rather than manufacturing and selling of actual semiconductor chips. They license IP to a network of partners and these partners utilize ARM IP designs to create and manufacture system-on-chip designs. In addition to processor IP, they provide a range of tools, physical and systems IP to enable optimized system-on-chip designs.

about_short_description.short_description: Arm Holdings is a multinational semiconductor company that designs, produces, and licenses IP for digital electronic product development.

product.name: Arm Architecture
product.description: Instruction-set, system, and security architecture specifications that define how Arm-based hardware and software interact and enable compatible, energy-efficient processor designs.

product.name: Arm CPU IP
product.description: Licensable processor-core IP spanning application, embedded, real-time, server, security, and custom-performance requirements across multiple computing markets.

product.name: Compute Subsystems (CSS)
product.description: Pre-integrated and verified compute subsystems that combine Arm processing components and supporting IP to reduce SoC design complexity and accelerate deployment.

product.name: Arm AGI CPU
product.description: Arm-designed server CPU silicon for AI data centers, intended to provide general-purpose processing for large-scale agentic and artificial-intelligence infrastructure.

product.name: Arm Mali GPUs
product.description: Graphics and multimedia processor IP for power-efficient rendering, display, imaging, and compute in mobile, consumer, and embedded devices.

product.name: Arm Ethos NPUs
product.description: Neural-processing-unit IP designed to accelerate machine-learning inference efficiently in embedded, mobile, and other edge devices.
